title: RCA, tour financing and original material

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: You said you eventually paid off all of those debts; right?
Yes, but it took a long time.
I could imagine. Did the record company, RCA specifically, did they finance the tours you did at all?
No, all they did was advance money to record, but we still haven't, and never will, get any money from those records.
You know, of course, that it's much more common now for a record company to finance a tour by a
performing group, or an appearance in a club or on television, or whatever.
I know that they do it, but they only do it under duress. They never really want to, they're forced to do it, and obviously they weren't in those days.
The other thing I wanted was to do all original things and that was not acceptable either by the record company.
